property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address that implements transferFrom(address,address,uint256), C.transfer always invokes that transferFrom ABI (selector keccak256("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)")) on the callee for each recipient; the mutant that switches the selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) will instead call a different function and thus the callee's recorded decoded arguments (and selector) can differ — the reference always causes the callee's transferFrom to be invoked, which the mutant does not for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the computed selector to a different function signature so external calls invoke a different function (likely causing different callee behavior and thus possibly different return outcomes).
